summary: The installer systemd unit omits AF_NETLINK, so discovery and probing are dead on every installed agent.
mitigation: Add AF_NETLINK to the RestrictAddressFamilies line of _INSTALL_SCRIPT_TEMPLATE in apps/backend/src/app/services/agent_install.py:87, then re-run the install command from Agents -> Add agent on already-enrolled hosts, which rewrites their unit file; until a fixed installer ships, the systemctl edit cb-agent drop-in documented in docs/agent.md restores netlink per host.
notes: Verified in the working tree on 2026-08-19. apps/backend/src/app/services/agent_install.py writes /etc/systemd/system/cb-agent.service at line 70 of _INSTALL_SCRIPT_TEMPLATE, and line 87 sets RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6; apps/agent/internal/collect/discover/neigh_linux.go:44 opens a unix.AF_NETLINK/NETLINK_ROUTE socket for the RTM_GETNEIGH dump, and Go net.Interfaces() on Linux is implemented over the same socket with no /sys fallback. Under the unit the daemon can therefore neither dump the neighbour cache nor enumerate its own interfaces, the derived direct_private scope arrives empty on the first capability.readiness frame, and every discovery target and probe destination is refused empty_scope before a packet is sent; MAC-based host linkage falls back to hostname. Telemetry, enrollment, the link, the spool and self-update are unaffected. The defect is invisible to the agent e2e suite, which runs the binary in a container with no systemd sandbox, and to cb-agent enroll, which runs from the operator shell. Disclosure gap: docs/agent.md - a page in the published nav at mkdocs.yml:34 - is the only place this defect is recorded. It appears in no known-bugs list, no exception, no gap-audit entry and no other ledger note, so the user manual disclosed it before release control did. No test pins the unit template, so the fix is one line, but whether 1.0.0 ships with the defect or with the fix is an owner decision; the alternative to fixing is an approved exception plus the per-host drop-in as the compensating control. The risk closes when the unit template grants AF_NETLINK and an installed agent is shown reporting discovery.neighbor: ready, or when an exception records the decision to ship as-is.
